DTRA is seeking mentor-protégé agreements (MPAs) that will assist protégés in enhancing their capabilities to provide value-added support to DTRA as it combats weapons of mass destruction and improvised threats and deters nuclear proliferation. 2.3 DTRA’s MPP is funded by the DoD’s Mentor Protégé Program. DTRA receives these funds and issues contractual agreements to approved mentor firms that provide incentives to Mentors for allowable mentoring expenses (a reimbursable MPA), provides small business subcontracting credit for allowable mentoring expenses (a credit MPA), or a combination of those two benefits (a hybrid MPA). 2.4 DISCLOSURE: The MPP was established as a pilot program and has periodically been reauthorized by Congress. On December 15, 2022, the U.S. Senate passed the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for the Fiscal Year 2023. Section 856 permanently codifies the Department of Defense’s (DOD) Mentor-Protégé Program (MPP). This agency cannot reimburse Mentor-Protégé teams for cost to develop their white papers and process their submittals. Overview: The DoD Me ntor-Protégé Program provides incentives to provide developmental assistance to eligible protégés by enhancing their capabilities to support DT RA’s strategic goals and objectives while delivering assistance that contains a strong technical component or focuses on innovative, state of the art technology, consistent with DTRA’s science and technology emphasis areas or strategic objectives (hereafter referred to as “Technology Transfer”). DTRA’s objective is to help foster the relationship between the mentor and the protégé to increase the industrial supplier base and enable the transition of eligible protégés from subcontractors to prime contractors. An additional intent is to increase subcontract opportunities under the Mentor's contracts, DoD contracts, other government agency contracts and commercial contracts, and to promote the establishment of long-term business relationships between eligible protégés, the mentor and other contractors. 4.2 Instruction: Interested mentors and protégés are responsible for submitting white papers relevant to DTRA’s science and technology emphasis areas.
